Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 3.name: Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 3
Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 3.summary: Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 3 is the sequel to the revolutionary Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2 for the Game Boy Advance. It's all about big air, grinding rails, riding ramps, jumping gaps and pulling the SICKEST tricks imaginable, all in the palm of your hand. Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 3 offers 1000+ tricks and four modes of gameplay.

Monster Trucks.name: Monster Trucks
Monster Trucks.summary: Tear up the track and crush metal in Monster Trucks for the Game Boy Advance! Build your ride in the scrap yard then work your way up to arena competitions in your quest to become the best on the circuit.

Need for Speed - Porsche Unleashed.name: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed
Need for Speed - Porsche Unleashed.summary: Game Boy Advance port of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed delivers the next level of open road racing experiences with an extensive collection of cars from the 50-year history of Porsche.
